'''Gurney''' was the generic term for a mobile platform or other medical conveyance.

==Description==
These devices were used to transport injured beings from the site of their injury to a [[Medcenter/Legends|medical facility]]. A [[repulsorlift stretcher]] was a type of gurney that was equipped with [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] technology. A device with a similar function, the [[medical cocoon]], was enclosed rather than open.

==History==
When [[Valin Horn]] became mentally unbound, healer [[Cilghal]] strapped him to a repulsor gurney and sent him to the neurology ward of the [[Halls of Healing|Jedi Medical Corps Infirmary]].

An advanced [[Medical capsule/Legends|medical capsule]] was used to transport a severely burned [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] from the lava fields of [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] and later into the [[Emperor Palpatine Surgical Reconstruction Center|EmPal SuRecon]] center. This may or may not be considered a gurney.

==Behind the scenes==
The [[in-universe]] origin of the term "gurney" is not known, but a human male by [[Gurney (Human)|that name]] worked at a [[Zelka Forn's medical facility|medical facility]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] circa [[3956 BBY]]. The real-world term may owe its name to J. Theodore Gurney.<ref>{{WebCite|url=http://ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=gurney|text=Gurney|archivedate=20210925124247}}</ref>
